title: WF Inventory — new layout (re-roll)
question: Second hand — the three previous structures are out. The roll leads with the Sheets Drawer. Keep the lead, take another dealt structure, steer, or re-roll again.

options.label: Sheets Drawer
options.lineage: collector's flat-file sheets with a pulled-out index card
options.thesis: Your inventory as one edge-to-edge sheet of cards; every filter lives in a left drawer that updates the wall as you move it — content first, chrome second.
options.viewport: Header with search, then a left facet drawer (Category / Market / Rank with live counts), and a dense 6-column card wall filling the rest; counts read 322 of 851 as filters apply.
options.risk: A 6-column wall at 1440 runs small cards; the drawer must never steal width the wall needs.

options.label: Console Deck
options.thesis: The search bar IS the page: type and the inventory narrows under your fingers, related items fan out below the best match.
options.viewport: Slim header, then a large centered command bar with query suggestions inline, match counts, and a 5-column results deck; empty state shows a category sample.
options.risk: Resting state is a search box, not an inventory scan; needs a good no-query display.

options.label: Category Belt
options.thesis: One scrolling belt of full-width category bands — Warframe, Primary, Melee, Archwing — each with its count bar and its own row of items; scroll is the navigation.
options.viewport: Header with search, then stacked category bands, each with a sticky banded header (count + fill bar) and a 4-across row of wide item cards.
options.risk: Long scroll before less-owned categories; bands must stay sticky-legible and the active band highlighted.
